inputs.role: independent readable historical control under Nov7-9

method.metric: Squared Mahalanobis distance in the first five coordinate counts; the sixth is determined by total length.
method.reference: All consecutive non-overlapping fixed-length blocks from each normalized source stream, starting at offset 0. No windows cross book boundaries.
method.erasures: Minimize target distance over every completion of its unknown coordinate counts; no source position is filled in a ciphertext.
method.square: Evaluate both 5/6 completions separately. These are only reference encodings, not new historical digit assignments.
method.convention_comparisons: Reported separately; repeated transformed text is not pooled or treated as independent evidence.
method.calibration: The mean and covariance are fitted only to the reference book windows. Reference fractions are descriptive empirical ranks, not p-values.

exact_F_invariant.proof: Every observed F must belong to a C/J/M/O/Q/Z or digit pair; only 7=FF contributes two. Transposition preserves coordinate totals.

exact_V_invariant.inequality: n_D + n_E + n_H + n_K + n_Q + n_T + n_U + 2*n_X <= 17
exact_V_invariant.conditional_bound: With r encoded X characters, n_D+n_E+n_H+n_K+n_Q+n_T+n_U <= 17-2*r; r must be between 0 and 8.
exact_V_invariant.proof: The two source erasures can add at most two V coordinates. The seven listed non-X letters use one V each, X=VV uses two, and all other V-bearing cells are digits. Digits consume the same budget and cannot relax the inequality.
exact_V_invariant.limitation: Conditional on Nov7-9 and preservation of all 176 observed coordinates. X need not be a separator, no X count is assigned, and this does not exclude an atypical historical body.

interpretation: Nov7-9 is a low-priority p73 square under the tested ordinary-German prose assumptions. This does not identify a different key, prove the October 26 origin, recover plaintext, or exclude atypical names, digits, code groups, another language, or other source damage.
control_limit: The word-X convention also puts the readable p155 A1 control beyond every reference window; it is therefore a visibly unsuitable convention for that body and must not be used as independent exclusion evidence.
